complete.title: Complete skull
complete.prompt: Document which bones are preserved and how mandibular articulation was reviewed. Completeness is an operator description.

partial.title: Partial skull / mixed fragments
partial.prompt: List the preserved regions and side of each fragment separately. Exclude ambiguous labels explicitly; one side of the vault says nothing about the opposite mandibular side.

no_mandible.title: Mandible absent
no_mandible.prompt: Confirm that enabled bone sources are cranial or nasal. Classify mixed sources before scientific export. Known mandibular marker labels are withheld.

deformed.title: Deformed skull
deformed.prompt: Document affected regions and any exclusions. Deformation is not diagnosed or corrected. Review full geometry QC for the saved scientific export.
